alt.summary: A burette held upright by a clamp stand above a conical flask on a white tile; the solution in the flask has turned pink, labelled as such.

parts.function: A long graduated tube that delivers a measured volume of one solution.
parts.name: Burette

parts.function: Controls how fast the solution runs out of the burette, down to single drops near the end point.
parts.name: Tap

parts.function: Holds the measured volume of the other solution; its shape lets you swirl it without spilling.
parts.name: Conical flask

parts.function: The solution in the flask with a few drops of indicator; its colour change shows the end point.
parts.name: Solution with indicator

parts.function: Sits under the flask so the colour change is easy to see.
parts.name: White tile

parts.function: Holds the burette upright and steady.
parts.name: Clamp stand

steps.caption: Fill the burette and read the starting volume at eye level.
Put a measured volume of the other solution and a few drops of indicator into the flask.
Open the tap and add the solution slowly while you swirl the flask.
Stop at the first lasting colour change, the end point, and read the final volume.
